name: Young Again: Season 2
source:
You start the game as Paul, an old man tired of his life, who after an incident (and by the will of a goddess) is now in the body of a 19-year-old boy (your character). Your mission is to fulfill a series of objectives for the goddess and thus be able to continue your life in this new body.

[Edited from [url=https://zargon-games.itch.io/young-again]Itch.io[/url]]
